surface.background: off-white matte editorial surface with no visible decorative pattern
surface.alternate: deep ink-blue canvas is reserved for an occasional inverted cover
surface.finish: quiet low-texture paper or matte print finish

palette_roles.foundation: ink-blue carries structure boundaries and the dominant editorial weight
palette_roles.primary_signal: one restrained clear blue marks the main signal or causal path
palette_roles.human_or_exception: at most one warm orange accent marks the exception pressure or human factor
palette_roles.neutral: cool pale gray supports subordinate objects without creating another accent
palette_roles.background: off-white remains the dominant field and preserves negative space

line_language.primary: uniform crisp three-pixel edges with mechanically consistent alignment
line_language.arrows: straight or single-elbow arrows without glow texture or sketch wobble
line_language.boundaries: flat precise boundaries with no ornamental circuitry or dashboard chrome

material_and_texture.surface: off-white matte editorial paper with extremely subtle texture
material_and_texture.objects: flat opaque geometry without glass gloss or volumetric material
material_and_texture.depth: no depth except an optional restrained two-pixel offset shadow

geometry.grid: flat twenty-four-pixel editorial grid with disciplined alignment
geometry.nodes: simple geometric objects with eight-pixel corners and crisp silhouettes
geometry.grouping: space rather than cards or frames groups two to four supporting objects
geometry.focal_rule: one dominant metaphor or comparison occupies the hierarchy

depth_and_camera.perspective: no isometric perspective three-dimensional extrusion or cinematic camera

typography.voice: modern sans-serif hierarchy with quiet captions
typography.exact_text: titles labels and technical copy are applied deterministically
typography.generated_text: image generation keeps supporting shapes label-free and reserves a title-safe zone

density_and_spacing.density: low-to-medium object density with one obvious focal relationship
density_and_spacing.spacing: large deliberate negative space and ninety-six-pixel outer breathing zones
density_and_spacing.rhythm: subordinate objects remain quiet and never compete with the focal thesis

required_traits: off-white matte field and large deliberate negative space dominate the composition
ink-blue structure and one clear blue signal establish the editorial hierarchy
uniform crisp geometry remains flat aligned and mechanically controlled
one focal metaphor or comparison is readable at thumbnail size
no more than one warm semantic exception appears in the composition
forbidden_traits: no hand-drawn strokes watercolor washes marker texture or playful doodles
no dashboard chrome card pile tiny interface text or ornamental frame system
no glossy three-dimensional module glass surface glow or decorative circuitry
no stock-photo people crowd scene or multiple competing visual accents
no emerald-led hierarchy because dominant emerald belongs to Style 2

neighbor_boundaries.difference: Style 1 is neutral off-white and ink-blue with one blue signal and one warm exception; Style 2 is emerald-led wider and more active across the canvas
